tests.common.start_hint: Click (or tap with the pen) to start
tests.rate.title: Report rate test
tests.rate.instructions: Draw large, continuous circles with the pen for about 5 seconds at your normal playing speed. This measures how many positions per second the cursor receives.
tests.stillness.title: Stability test
tests.stillness.instructions: Rest the pen tip on the tablet and do not move it for about 5 seconds. You can also hold it in the air, very close to the surface (hover), without moving it. This measures how much the cursor shakes.
tests.tracking.title: Tracking test
tests.tracking.instructions: A pink dot will move in a figure eight at constant speed for about 8 seconds. Follow the dot with your cursor as closely as you can. This measures delay, error and smoothness.
tests.aim.title: Aim test
tests.aim.instructions: 20 circles will appear one at a time. Click the center of each one (pen tip is left click) quickly and accurately.
